## Documented role

[Van der Klift and Norman Kunc, “Hell-Bent on Helping” (1994)](../sources/1994-van-der-klift-hell-bent.qmd) is a published chapter on help and inclusive education. It does not name ECPM, CSIL, BC Rehab, Greater Vancouver Home Support Society, or Vancouver Health Department. No inspected public source in this pass identifies her as author of a 1994 ECPM training manual.
